notes: A menu bar (File, Edit, View, Takeoff, Tools, Help) and new two-colour toolbar icons, with the toolbar tidied up. Right-click menus come in groups with icons and Delete in red at the bottom; colour, material and tags are in sub-menus. Ctrl+click a page in Go To Page to open it in a new tab. Pick Run: with runs picked, click their label to put them into its item; the first time it asks which item and the job remembers it.
